name: reviewdna-workspace
description: Mine code-review history into evidence-backed engineering rules for humans and AI coding agents.

scripts.clean: find apps packages -type d -name dist -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
scripts.demo: npm run build && node apps/cli/dist/index.js analyze-fixture fixtures/reviews.json --out demo-output
scripts.benchmark: npm run build && node scripts/benchmark.mjs && node scripts/semantic-benchmark.mjs
